items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And Sy Oliver was there in the band. ... And we were stationed in Columbus, Ohio. And Sy Oliver was there

ctx.x: Toby." So that -- so after we played Philly we finally went to Newport News and fooled around. Finally the band made our way back to Kansas City. Then I was pretty well fed up so I wrote to Zach White in Columbus, Ohio and he sent for me and I went out to Columbus, Ohio to join Zach White. And Sy Oliver was there in the band.
What was the difference from the Moten band, you know, from the other bands you'd been playing with? That Kansas City thing, did you recognize the variations in styles?
